name: Mito Yuuri
source:
The offspring of Kageharu Yachimata, who sealed Tayutais together with Kikuramikami no Hime five hundred years ago.

He mastered Demon-repelling Power just like his ancestors through training. Together with his wife, [url=/c41668]Mito Mashiro[/url], they lead the Tayutais that are set free and devote themselves in realizing the "Coexistence between Humans and Tayutais."

[Edited from [url=http://hikarifield.com/tayutama2_en/character/character004.html]English Website[/url]]
